notes: Condition metadata and nominal budgets are read from frozen per-shard protocol manifests; no condition-level metric rows were used to construct this registry.
a3_baseline is the low-profile reference and is reused as the nominal LLL profile in B2; it is not duplicated as another condition.

The four true-global levels present in the 30-condition manifest exceed the older RUN_BUDGET table entry of three true-global controls. Preserve the executed manifest inventory (30); record this protocol-count discrepancy for provenance rather than silently recoding conditions.
The separate generic-extension campaign is post-lock and is not promoted into a confirmatory family by this registry.
